native_verification.scope:
Compare life runtime behavior with original ARM64 LifeHelper and life data writes.

Actual original query/mutation bodies, nested life calls and model stores execute
from ELF. User gold/weekly-pass status, server clock, application/context queries,
analytics and table writes are explicit ports. Diagnostic log construction is
skipped; BasicUserData/Chest model assignments and their table call execute.
This does not restore TimeHelper/backend/app lifecycle or bind production startup.

actual_life_storage_verification.scope: Runtime LifeHelper, Basic/Inventory owners, native local account/area loader and real private Windows SQLite storage. Controlled server time, pass status, app callbacks and analytics are explicit inputs. Not production TimeHelper/backend/app startup, full WinFail/GameScene composition, Home/navigation or Android/iOS proof.

Physical input, dynamic camera/orientation, King/boosters, startup/account/settlement/Home/navigation and full original rendered parity remain incomplete.

player_input_regression.scope: Frame-separated recorded device samples through native GameTouchListener into formal production scene services. Checks invalid swap spends0, accepted swaps spend1, first triple/three box goals/six refills, 10accepted swaps and naturally observed special creation patterns (each requested type also has its own activation mode), automatic cascades, original creation coroutines and all72 model slots/no holes/no freeze/landing tolerance. Does not verify physical drag timing, special activation/combos, complete session startup, settlement or original rendered parity.

batch.scope: Isolated Unity batch editor opens the unchanged formal scene and runs existing explicit verifiers after real runtime startup. No editor runtime fallback or gameplay substitutes. Does not verify physical pointer input or rendered-original parity.

background_verification.scope: Independent source/cache copy; unchanged production scene and runtime. Existing explicit test transport only. No physical-input or original rendered-parity claim.

restored_scope: LifeHelper constructor, typed Bind subscription, max5/8 pass-dependent cap, future-full-time correction, lives/full/available/unlimited queries, refill/increment/decrement and native time display/reward methods. Server clock, gold/weekly-pass entitlement, application callbacks/context and analytics are required typed dependencies, with no wall-clock/default substitutes.

BasicUserData full/unlimited timestamps and UserInventory Chest updates mutate actual existing models then write their original UserKeyValue rows. Explicit model storage binding belongs to account composition; no alternate save format or Editor fallback is added. Paused unlimited-life minutes preserve native inclusive0..15 bits and unmasked new-value packing.

The first independent Unity compile exposed that FullLivesTimeInMs had an internal setter although original metadata declares public set_FullLivesTimeInMs0x2f81bec. Restore that public model setter, retain the failed compiler report, and verify the corrected snapshot without an Editor-specific initialization path.

3102 differential cases execute original ARM64 query/mutation methods, nested life calls, actual model stores and table calls. Controlled ports cover feature/time/application/analytics/storage and TimeSpan conversion; diagnostic logging is skipped. Boundary, signed overflow, absent owners, storage failures, advancing time, rollback, current-user/model/time/pass changes are compared with runtime C# state and side-effect order.

Exact recovery-interval boundaries retain the native asymmetry: at full-now==oneInterval, GetLives reports3 for cap5 while HasLives is true; after the first millisecond GetLives reports4. Display uses truncated integer seconds. No guessed ceiling/clamping correction replaces the original body.

Private Unity SQLite integration runs actual fresh account/area loading, app-start correction, debit/exhaustion/grant/recovery, unlimited reward/rollback, packed paused minutes, pass cap, local sync flags and reopen without writing restored defaults. Controlled clock/pass/app/analytics inputs remain explicit fixture boundaries.

GameStart integration fixture now forwards its debit to the actual runtime LifeHelper and real Basic timestamp/SQLite storage rather than counting alone. Native RestoreGame does not call the fresh debit again. The fixture is not promoted to production scene composition.

The actual normal GameScene/camera/lighting/72-view checks and existing10 accepted/1 rejected swaps,76 refills,2 specials,20 moves/no-hole/no-freeze checks pass on the same frozen snapshot. Life work does not supply the missing production WinFail/Home owners or prove original rendered parity.

Full camera/grid safe-area/offset/entrance lifecycle,112 factories, all levels/events/regions/AB/GM routes, original visual parity and Android/iOS runtime remain required. SDK facade behavior is unchanged.
performance: Life queries and arithmetic use scalar values and cached owners. Storage updates occur on life/reward changes; no per-frame lookup, LINQ, new object pool, heavy asset preload or additional assembly is introduced. Verification reuses the existing isolated incremental cache and never operates the source editor foreground.
